alt: Farah and Demir set blend weights from prior errors before evaluating the combined forecast.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Recompose the LAST reference into a 1536x1024 landscape Deep Orbit lesson scene. References 1 through 2 are canonical identity authorities in this order: dr-farah, ensign-demir. Reference 3 is the room authority; reference 4 is the original edit target for story action, lighting and palette only. Preserve exact recognizable canonical facial structure, eye spacing, nose, jaw, mouth, complexion, age and signature equipment. Exactly 2 humans, the named cast only. Preserve balanced adult proportions and candid expressions. Exactly two complete arms per person, each from its own shoulder through one elbow and neutral wrist to one plausible hand. Ordinary thumb sides, fingers and natural object contact; no extra arm or bent prop. No camera-facing portraits. Faces visible naturally three-quarter with eyes directed toward work or each other. Use available empty wall or upper space for a large upright primary lesson display that is physically plausible and faces its operators. All text and lines follow the display plane, crisp and generously sized with comfortable margins. Keep essential content fully visible. Never put the sole lesson evidence upside down on paper or flat table, or on a tiny tabletop screen beneath a blank wall. Secondary paper can face its owner, but essential content is repeated upright. Remove meaningless decorative technical labels. No generic success verdicts, invented numbers, speech bubbles, watermarks or signatures. Dr. Farah: medium-brown skin, dark tied hair, gray lab coat, earrings and translucent green AR lens over her left eye. Ensign Demir: young adult man, light warm skin with freckles, thick dark swept hair, short stubble, charcoal jumpsuit and green ear device.
Specific action and staging: Farah and Demir lean over the engineering blending controls. Farah operates a mouse while looking at the new large upright shared wall screen; her other hand braces on the bench. Demir turns one large tactile dial with one hand and steadies himself on the rail with the other, watching Farah with thoughtful curiosity. Preserve the hands-on blending action and warm brass engineering setting. Move the previously upside-down weights onto the upright screen.
Exact visible display content: Title "Prior-period errors set weights". Three-row table with headers "Model", "MAE", "Rounded weight": "LSTM | 0.045 | 0.333", "Attention | 0.038 | 0.467", "Kalman | 0.058 | 0.200". Arrows from all three rows to "Weighted blend". Footer "Weights sum to 1. Evaluate on a separate period.". No invented winning result.
